data.title: Oxygen Delivery
data.description: Muscles need oxygen to move. Build the path oxygen takes from outside each animal to a working muscle.

challenges.name: whale
challenges.intro: Whales are giant ocean swimmers that glide through deep, chilly water.
challenges.instruction: Build the path that gets oxygen to the whale's tail muscle.
challenges.principle: A whale takes in fresh air at the ocean surface and sends oxygen through its blood to its tail muscle.

jobs.blowhole: Opening at the water surface to take in fresh air.
jobs.windpipe: Guiding the air down into the chest.
jobs.lungs: Putting oxygen from the air into the blood.
jobs.heart: Pumping the blood full of oxygen with a mighty beat.
jobs.blood_tubes: Carrying oxygen straight into the swimming muscle.

challenges.name: fish
challenges.intro: Fish live in rivers, lakes, and oceans where they splash and swim all day long.
challenges.instruction: Build the path that gets oxygen to the fish's tail muscle.
challenges.principle: A fish takes oxygen from the water and carries it through blood to its swimming muscles.

jobs.mouth: Taking in water as the fish swims along.
jobs.gills: Catching oxygen from the water and putting it into the blood.
jobs.heart: Pumping the blood forward through the body.
jobs.blood_tubes: Delivering oxygen right to the moving fin muscle.

challenges.name: person
challenges.intro: Humans live on land and love to walk, run, and play games.
challenges.instruction: Build the path that gets oxygen to the person's leg muscle.
challenges.principle: A person breathes in air and moves oxygen through the blood to every working muscle.

jobs.nose: Taking in fresh air from the outside world.
jobs.windpipe: Letting the air slide down toward the chest.
jobs.lungs: Passing oxygen from the air into the blood.
jobs.heart: Pumping the fresh blood onward with each beat.
jobs.blood_tubes: Carrying oxygen all the way into the running muscle.
